name: Nivolumab + Ipilimumab, then Nivolumab maintenance (CheckMate-214)
cyclesNote: Induction: 4 cycles of nivolumab 3 mg/kg + ipilimumab 1 mg/kg IV every 3 weeks. Then MAINTENANCE: single-agent nivolumab (ipilimumab stopped) continued until progression or unacceptable toxicity (per DeVita 12th ed., line 33128). The exact maintenance flat schedule follows the nivolumab label (e.g., 240 mg every 2 weeks or 480 mg every 4 weeks).

source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: Clear cell RCC (subtypes #55/#56). Dual checkpoint blockade (nivolumab anti-PD-1 + ipilimumab anti-CTLA-4). CheckMate-214 established the combination versus sunitinib; the OS/ORR benefit was in intermediate-/poor-risk (IMDC) disease. No positive companion biomarker is required to start (PD-L1 not required). Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Kidney Cancer v1.2027 (Ipilimumab + Nivolumab, category 1).

supportiveCare: Immune-related adverse event (irAE) monitoring across organ systems (thyroid and other endocrinopathies, hepatitis, colitis/diarrhea, pneumonitis, dermatitis, nephritis); dual checkpoint blockade carries a higher irAE rate than PD-1 monotherapy.
Baseline and periodic thyroid (TSH/free T4), liver function, glucose, and cortisol/ACTH as indicated.
Patient counseling on prompt reporting of irAE symptoms.
monitoring: immune-related toxicity screen (TSH/free T4, LFTs, glucose, cortisol) before each cycle and as indicated
symptom review for colitis, pneumonitis, dermatitis, endocrinopathy

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 2 or higher immune-related adverse event
doseModificationRules.text: Hold checkpoint inhibitor(s) and manage with corticosteroids per immune-related adverse event guidance; permanent discontinuation for severe/grade 3-4 irAE. Obtain clinical review before rechallenge.

drugs.name: Nivolumab
drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., line 33128: nivolumab 3 mg/kg IV combined with ipilimumab 1 mg/kg IV every 3 weeks for up to 4 induction cycles, then single-agent nivolumab maintenance. Induction dose modeled here (day 1, q21). Maintenance is single-agent nivolumab per DeVita; the exact maintenance flat schedule (e.g., 240 mg every 2 weeks or 480 mg every 4 weeks per label) is described in regimen.cycles and is a labeling detail, not modeled as a separate numeric drug dose.
